provenance.scope: Historical v0.2 acceptance rows, captured for distribution; this is not a current verification run.
provenance.normalization: Source file hash: raw checkout bytes. Row hashes: Weave csv-row-v1 canonical rows.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Unknown fields/operators and malformed transactions are rejected before preview.
rows.required_evidence: Schema and semantic-validator negative fixtures.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Rule-table and state-view edits of the same meaning yield the same semantic transaction and domain hash.
rows.required_evidence: Round-trip command/projection integration test.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Layout-only edits preserve domain hash and domain receipts; presentation hash changes and affected UI evidence is reconsidered.
rows.required_evidence: Before/after subject and receipt applicability assertions.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Layout coordinate metadata and presentation invalidation tested; drag/drop and UI-evidence system absent.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Preview and save do not change baseline files, aggregate state or external effects.
rows.required_evidence: Filesystem/database snapshots and effect-log assertions.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Discard restores the prior baseline without candidate data leakage.
rows.required_evidence: Snapshot and actor-isolation test.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Discard preserves baseline and closes candidate; history retained deliberately, not erased. No multi-tenant actor-isolation study.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: A stale baseline or aggregate version rejects apply; no silent overwrite or implicit rebase.
rows.required_evidence: Two-candidate interleaving test.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Ambiguous sign-off request remains proposed until an explicit authority chooses an interpretation.
rows.required_evidence: Request-to-transaction integration trace.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: The proposing agent cannot approve its own change; missing reviewer capability blocks apply.
rows.required_evidence: Distinct actor identities and negative capability test.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Capability tests and restricted provider port pass; same OS user can impersonate owner. No adversarial identity separation.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Teacher final approval is denied under every candidate path and direct API call.
rows.required_evidence: Hand-authored authority oracle and bypass mutations.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Recommend requires active and assigned actor from trusted fixture state; missing/unknown resolver blocks rather than ignores.
rows.required_evidence: Assigned/unassigned/inactive/unsupported predicate tests.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Role or assignment revocation after preview is checked at commit and blocks stale authority.
rows.required_evidence: Time-of-check/time-of-use interleaving test.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Recommend requires Submitted; registrar Approve/Reject requires Recommended; Submit and Revise remain valid.
rows.required_evidence: Exhaustive bounded role/state/action matrix with independent expected outcomes.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Default 125-cell matrix passes with same-author oracle, not independent. Explicit rejection-source edit changes the original prerequisite.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: One accepted Recommend produces one audit append and at-most-once local notification enqueue; payments/export never occur.
rows.required_evidence: Transactional event/outbox assertions and forbidden-effect mutants.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Duplicate operation replay binds actor, target and payload; mismatched reuse is denied and replay does not bypass current authority.
rows.required_evidence: Replay/cross-actor/payload-conflict negative tests.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Success appears only after commit; failure/stale version never renders Recommended/Approved as achieved.
rows.required_evidence: Runtime trace plus browser observation of commit/failure cases.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Actual committed runtime + bridged Chromium denial checks pass; ordinary browser-network E2E blocked.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Typed traversal reaches beyond depth five and terminates on cycles; capped traversal returns complete=false and a frontier.
rows.required_evidence: Deep chain, cycle and budget-exhaustion tests with independently enumerated oracle.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Affected evidence and approvals become inapplicable after material edits; original receipt payloads remain unchanged.
rows.required_evidence: Receipt hash preservation and applicability assertions.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Wrong model/core/build/policy/environment/harness identities cannot satisfy a required claim.
rows.required_evidence: Subject substitution and stale-context mutations.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Browser/synthetic evidence cannot satisfy a claim about real teacher comprehension.
rows.required_evidence: Historical relabel counterexample adapted to integrated computed gate.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Caller-supplied PASS/current/admissible/approved flags cannot override independently computed policy.
rows.required_evidence: Forged input and missing raw-artifact provenance tests.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: All projected labels distinguish recommendation from final approval; changed registrar prerequisites are explicit.
rows.required_evidence: Projection consistency and critical reviewer questions; real comprehension remains separate.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Generated authority/prerequisite labels and questions tested; no human comprehension study.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Approval is bound to reviewer, scope and exact subject; a material edit during review invalidates it before local apply.
rows.required_evidence: Review/apply race test and signed-in fixture identity checks.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Local signed subject/baseline/version checks pass; no real signed-in institutional identity.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Core change or unsupported semantics requires source-level review; ordinary approval cannot silently bless it.
rows.required_evidence: Core hash change and unsupported-operation tests.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Core fixture mismatch and unsupported operators block; fixture is self-authored, not independent source review.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Technical eligibility may coexist with visible human UNKNOWN; field-use scope requiring that claim cannot pass.
rows.required_evidence: Decision policy tests across local-demo and field-use scopes.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Export includes original intent, transaction, before/after subject, completeness, receipts, traces, decision and unknowns with verified hashes.
rows.required_evidence: Round-trip export validation and immutable artifact manifest.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Export covers case/model/receipts/trace/decision/unknowns with payload hash; no trusted import or external attestation.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: An independent hidden mutation set tests authority, assignment, omissions, evidence, labels, effects and approval; no compensating aggregate score.
rows.required_evidence: Holdout mutation results with author/oracle provenance.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Independent hidden mutation evaluation not performed.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: If SQLite persistence is implemented, workflow/operation/audit/outbox commit atomically and crash tests expose no partial accepted operation.
rows.required_evidence: Failure-injection/restart tests; otherwise durability stays out of claim scope.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: Exercised within supported synthetic/local grammar; not a universal claim.

rows.observable_acceptance_criterion: Reviewer benefit is not labelled measured until an actual counterbalanced task study records correctness, errors, time and full effort.
rows.required_evidence: Study protocol and real anonymised observations; NOT_RUN in this release.
rows.v0_2_scope_note: No actual human task study performed.
